Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
The problem I see with imbued is not their defence. If given setup time, they make nearly unoustable walls of intercept, combat damage and some reduce. Because of this they seem to time out games with maybe a result of 1.5/0.5/0.5/0.5/0 breakdowns (unless someone cross-table is bleeding like a maniac).

Imbued need some go-forward if anything. They need an encouragement not to be a wall. +bleed would be my recommendation or ways to deal pool damage for torpored vampires.

Ends justify the Means
Unique Master
Requires a ready Imbued //Maybe just one of the 'groups'
Put this card in play. Your Imbued may take an action costing 2 conviction  to give a vampire in torpor a Captive counter. A vampire with a Captive counter cannot be a target of cards or actions. A Methuselah burns 1 pool each Untap for each Captive Counter on their minions. A minion may burn a Captive Counter and put the vampire who had the counter in the ready region as a +1 stealth  action costing 2 blood.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
It was a deliberate variant of Carver's Meat Packing & Storage.
I didn't want this card to trigger Carver's text, which means it needs a counter that is NOT a Hostage counter.
I also wanted the counters to not have a 'memory' just a name. So that the card in play gives the counters in play their meaning.
